simple.summary: קֵא (qêʼ) means vomit First listed occurrence: Isa 19 14.

definitions.full: H6892. qe [ קֵא ] noun [masculine] what is vomited up, vomit (see Ba NB 79 ); — suffix קֵאוֺ Prov 26:11 (of dog). קִיא noun masculine id. (see Ba NB 80 ); — absolute ׳ק Isa 28:8 ; suffix קִיאוֺ 19:14 (simile); figurative Jer 48:26 (of Moab).
